name: claude-utils
description: Small Claude Code plugins: reply in the user's language, keep the computer awake and unlocked

plugins.name: reply-language
plugins.description: Detects the language of each prompt, tells Claude to reply and think in it, and makes Claude rewrite replies written in another language.

plugins.name: keep-unlocked
plugins.description: Keeps the computer from sleeping, starting the screen saver or idle-locking while Claude Code runs (macOS, Windows; Linux best-effort).
